technical_and_design_decisions: Use Spring Cloud Netflix Eureka client for service registration and discovery.
Refactor existing controllers to use Spring Integration and Spring Boot Actuator APIs for metrics collection.
Implement SPI-based controller architecture to support pluggable Admin SPI implementations.
Use Spring Cloud Stream for module metrics persistence and relay via REST APIs.
Leverage Spring Boot Actuator's export() API for periodic metrics snapshots with Redis as default backend.
Use Docker multi-stage builds for module-launcher image creation and CI pipeline integration with DockerHub.
Port existing XD FTP modules to Spring Cloud Stream compliant source modules.
assumptions: Developers are already familiar with Spring Cloud, Spring Boot, and Spring Integration frameworks.
Existing CI infrastructure (e.g., Jenkins or GitHub Actions) is available and configured.
DockerHub credentials and permissions for springcloud organization are accessible.
Eureka server is already deployed or will be set up as part of the environment.
Redis is available as the default metrics storage backend.
Module-launcher refers to a Dockerized runtime for launching Spring Cloud Stream modules.
FTP modules from XD can be adapted to Spring Cloud Stream with minimal protocol changes.

activities.activity_description: Implement Eureka client integration to allow modules to register and update their state with Eureka server.
Refactor ContainersController, StreamsController, ModulesController, and JobsController to use SPI-based Admin implementations.

activities.activity_name: Capture Module Metrics via REST APIs
activities.activity_description: Implement metrics capture for modules using Spring Integration channel() and Spring Boot actuator() APIs, exposed via REST.

activities.activity_name: Self-Register XD Admin Server with Eureka
activities.activity_description: Enable xd-admin server to self-register with Eureka for service discovery.
Configure CI pipeline to automatically build and test code commits for Spring Cloud Stream.

activities.activity_name: Port FTP Modules from XD to s-c-s
activities.activity_description: Migrate existing XD FTP modules to Spring Cloud Stream source modules.

activities.activity_name: Persist Module Metrics via REST APIs
activities.activity_description: Implement metrics persistence using Spring Boot Actuator export() API with Redis, exposed via REST APIs.

activities.activity_name: CI Workflow for Module-Launcher Docker Image
activities.activity_description: Create CI workflow to build, bundle, and upload module-launcher Docker image to DockerHub springcloud repository.
